messages:
marta: quick note. ran a focused long-doc batch on nova9b int8 -> fp16 comparison. numbers below, plus two low-risk rollout options.
lee: drop the numbers pls.
marta: results (slice=enterprise-digest, avg input ~1200 tokens, N=500):
```
- p95 latency: fp16 220ms | int8 260ms
- tokens/sec: fp16 0.85 | int8 0.36
- cost/1k tokens: fp16 $0.0092 | int8 $0.0039
- recall@5: fp16 81.0% | int8 76.0% (delta -5.0pp)
- rouge-l: -4.6 pts
- hallucination rate heuristic: fp16 1.8% | int8 6.0%
```
link: https://internal.redwood/sparkbench/nova9b/3100012222
devin: econ math: ~2.35x token cost win. but hallucination uptick is worrying for enterprise customers who cite compliance/accuracy.
ryan: product: enterprise digest triggers support escalations. recommend hybrid: default int8 but route known enterprise accounts -> fp16.
marta: rollout plan: 1) opt-in enterprise accounts to fp16 by config 2) global int8 default with monitoring 3) try KVCACHE to lower fp16 costs for enterprise 4) measure support tickets and escalation signal.
devin: ops playbook snippet and canary creation in progress.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary job created: nova9b-int8-enterprise-probe at 10% enterprise traffic -> fistful of fp16 fallbacks. See https://internal.redwood/deploys/3100012222
lee: thanks all. will coordinate with customer success for controlled opt-ins.
marta: i'll post the sample failure cases separately. :white_check_mark:
